svg.title: Infrastructure Issue Pattern Detection Workflow
svg.desc: Five-step process to identify systemic infrastructure failures versus isolated customer issues

g.text: Extract pod, cluster, shard, or server from ticket metadata or message
Start with 90 days; expand to 180 if results sparse
Find all support tickets for this infrastructure node (up to 50)
Classify each ticket into 8 categories; count distribution
Apply thresholds to determine if systemic or isolated
Systemic flag + recommended action + ticket links
Ready for escalation or customer investigation

svg.text: Total time: 2-5 minutes vs. 2 hours of investigation

g.text: Export, report, data pull operations fail
Login, SSO, session, token validation fails
Web interface, forms, content won't display
Data mismatch, replication lag, sync issues
